aiOverview.content: A South Carolina Blue Alert was issued for Lacey Nicole Cushman, 37, after a shooting involving a law enforcement officer in Barnwell County (Blackville area) on Monday, April 20, 2026. The suspect, deemed armed and dangerous, was last seen in a 2011 white Chevrolet Traverse (SC tag 7061RU).
